**Capabilities added to `@versionless/angular`** (all three closure- or compiler-driven, no memorized tables, refusal over half-edits):

- `/Users/jacksm5pro/dev/open-source/versionless/packages/frameworks/angular/src/barrel-entry-point-split.ts` — enumerates the installed package's own `exports` map, parses each entry point's declaration file, maps each barrel symbol to the shallowest entry point that exports it, refuses unmapped and ambiguous names, and refuses the whole declaration if any one symbol fails.
- `/Users/jacksm5pro/dev/open-source/versionless/packages/frameworks/angular/src/node-core-binding-migration.ts` — expands Node `util` bindings into ECMAScript, each template mentioning its argument exactly once (`isNullOrUndefined(x)` → `(x == null)`); `format` becomes a template literal only for literal `%s`-only strings with matching arity, with the object-inspection divergence declared per call site.
- `/Users/jacksm5pro/dev/open-source/versionless/packages/frameworks/angular/src/rxjs-prototype-patch-migration.ts` — takes the compiler's TS2339 positions (the only thing that separates an observable's `.map` from an array's), moves instance operators into `pipe(...)` and statics to free functions, verifies every emitted name against the installed rxjs surface, and drops `rxjs/add/**` only where every named call site in that module moved.
